data.title: AWC seeds new AWR REIT with five assets worth 48.4bn baht
data.description: AWC plans to transfer five premium properties worth at least 48.449 billion baht into its new multi-sector AWR REIT, with another nine projects under study.

data.title: Northern property market slows new launches as Chiang Mai faces four-year stock overhang
data.description: Northern Thailand’s housing market is recovering gradually, but weak purchasing power and tight lending are slowing new launches, while Chiang Mai may need more than four years to clear existing stock.

data.title: SET and NYSE sign Sept 24 pact for listings on two markets
data.description: The Thai and New York exchanges will cooperate on funds, indices and sustainability products to widen funding and investment options in Thailand

data.title: GRAND’s September 22 plan caps Westin Sukhumvit asset sale at 494.60 million baht
data.description: GRAND says a severe cash shortage led to rent defaults and termination of a land lease at Bangkok’s Westin Grande Sukhumvit hotel.

data.title: Condo sales rebound as low-rise housing stock takes 67 months to clear
data.description: Condo sales in Bangkok and five surrounding provinces rose 19.5% in Q2 2026, while low-rise housing inventory could take 67 months to clear.

data.title: Vietnam officially gains emerging market status in FTSE Russell index
data.description: The upgrade from frontier to emerging market status could attract up to US$6 billion, while Vietnam's phased index inclusion will run through 2027.

data.title: Buffett steps down as Berkshire chair on September 18 after over 60 years at the helm
data.description: Howard Buffett takes over as chairman of US group Berkshire Hathaway, while Warren Buffett becomes chairman emeritus and remains a director

data.title: ROH Contests GROREIT Asset Sale Resolution, Maintaining Contractual Buyback Rights for Sheraton Hotel
data.description: Royal Orchid Hotel challenges GROREIT’s assertion that its repurchase rights have expired, seeking legal counsel ahead of a critical unitholder vote

data.title: Thai Banks Bet on Blockchain to Make Carbon Credits Trusted
data.description: Tokenised mangrove credits and a global registry are moving from concept to pilot – but Veolia warns the hard part is still what happens on the ground

data.title: Spot gold gains 0.3% on September 18 as oil prices fall
data.description: Gold reached a one-week high in global trading and was on course for a first weekly gain in four weeks, despite a stronger US dollar

data.title: Gold rises 2.3% on Sept 17 as dollar and oil prices fall
data.description: Spot gold traded at US$4,351.96 an ounce early on September 18 in Singapore as lower oil prices and Treasury yields eased pressure on bullion

data.title: BOT and Trade Chamber plan December Credit Portal after 16 quarters of SME loan decline
data.description: Thailand’s planned Credit Portal would let small firms approach up to five lenders for refinancing, with testing due in November

data.title: Royal Orchid Sheraton draws THB5.3bn offer ahead of sale vote
data.description: GROREIT unitholders will vote on Royal Orchid Sheraton sale options on October 28, including a THB5.3 billion offer from Orchid Hospitality.

data.title: Phuket property market hits 705bn baht as foreign buyers drive resort demand
data.description: Phuket has more than 90,000 residential units worth 705 billion baht on the market, with resort properties accounting for 52% of supply and foreign demand driving growth.

data.title: Thai-China forum promotes sustainable investment in Rayong
data.description: Thai and Chinese business groups are expanding support for Chinese investors in Rayong, with a forum focusing on rules, jobs, technology and community ties.

data.title: BOT targets USDT laundering risks in 500–600bn baht half-year inflows
data.description: Thailand’s central bank governor proposes a 0.01% gold trading tax to improve transaction reporting as part of efforts to curb money laundering

data.title: Condo transfers to foreigners rise 1.4% in Q2 2026, REIC reports
data.description: Chinese buyers led Thailand’s foreign condo transfers, but the first-half 2026 total fell 8.8% to 6,533 units despite a second-quarter recovery

data.title: Nok Krasip connects small traders with AI tools and bank loans
data.description: Nok Krasip links AI sales tools with bank loans, including up to THB500,000 for small traders and a separate SME option offering up to THB3 million.

data.title: Rayong's new Wang Chan town plan shapes EEC land development
data.description: The new Wang Chan town plan in Rayong sets clear land use rules to support EEC growth while protecting agricultural areas and natural resources.

data.title: Don Mueang’s transport links draw luxury housing investment
data.description: Sansiri plans September 12–13 presales for Don Mueang homes priced at 15–40 million baht, about 400 metres from the Red Line station.
